content.text:
Micron Stock Finds a Spark as Rival Downplays AI Growth Fears
Micron stock was showing signs of life on Thursday. That’s a welcome development for the memory-chip maker, which has lost some of its luster lately as investors worry about a slowdown in artificial-intelligence spending.
